ok.description: False when the lint found errors; the part is then not written.

path.description: The file written with -o, or null.

module.description: The circuitoon-module/1 part, with "custom": true and an id starting with "custom-".

notes.description: What the part maker adjusted (numbered repeated names, a left-out name plate), then the lint notes, such as a custom part still drawn as the generic box.
